name: August 15th, 1945
source:
Korea is liberated from the Japanese rule on the exact date of August 15th, 1945, following the end of World War II—it had been a hard time fighting for independence. Japan’s surrender announcement via the radio was unclear to most Koreans at the time as it used very vague, formal wording. Thus, it was not until the next day or even later that word was spread of their own freedom. The video game, in the form of a visual novel, follows the protagonist as they gather clues after hearing the broadcast in order to reveal what changes it would bring in their country. Following a linear story incorporating a few player choices, the player gets to experience what it felt like to live in Korea when it was a Japanese colony. Through the narrative and the characters presented, they learn how the country gained their independence and how it was a big triumph, a truly monumental day celebrated and remembered by the nation every year, to this day.

[From [url=https://tayareum.itch.io/august-15th-1945]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
第二次世界大战结束后的1945年8月15日，朝鲜从日本的统治下解放出来——这是争取独立的艰难时期。当时大多数韩国人都不清楚日本通过广播宣布的投降声明，因为它使用了非常模糊、正式的措辞。于是，直到第二天甚至更晚的时候，他们自由的消息才被传开。这款视频游戏采用视觉小说的形式，跟随主角在听到广播后收集线索，以揭示它将给他们的国家带来什么变化。遵循包含一些玩家选择的线性故事，玩家可以体验在日本殖民地时期生活在韩国的感觉。通过叙述和呈现的人物，他们了解了这个国家如何获得独立，以及这是如何取得的巨大胜利，这是一个真正具有纪念意义的日子，每年都被这个国家庆祝和铭记，直到今天。
